entries.jp: バーンシュタイン兵隊長
やっぱり俺じゃダメか‥‥。
entries.en: Guess I wasn't up to it after all...

entries.jp: こんな奴らに、勝てるわけねぇよ‥‥
entries.en: We never stood a chance against these guys...

entries.jp: ちょっと油断しちまったか‥‥
entries.en: Guess I let my guard down a little...

entries.jp: なんで俺がこんな目に‥‥
{v:0020}１つ聞きたいことがある。{p}{v:0021}学院長とはどんな関係があった？
entries.en: {v:0020}There's one thing I want to ask.{p}{v:0021}What was your connection to the Headmaster?

entries.jp: {v:0022}そういや、お前たちがマクスウェルを倒したそうだな。{n}それに関しちゃ、感謝半分、迷惑半分だったぜ。
entries.en: {v:0022}Oh, right. I hear you lot took down Maxwell. Can't{n}decide whether to thank you or curse you for that.

entries.jp: {v:0024}わからねぇのか？{n}奴から武器に使う魔法や魔水晶を仕入れていたんだよ。{p}{v:0025}ま、そろそろヤバイと思っていた頃だがな。
entries.en: {v:0024}Can't figure it out? I bought magic and magic crystals{n}from him to use in my weapons.{p}{v:0025}Still, I was starting to think it was getting risky.

entries.jp: {v:0026}それじゃ、水晶鉱山の横流しは‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0026}Then the smuggling at the crystal mine...

entries.jp: {v:0027}おおかた、マクスウェルと組むようになって{n}邪魔になった仲介業者ってとこだろ？{p}{v:0028}だから奴に命じて始末させた。{n}違うか？
entries.en: {v:0027}I'm guessing the middleman became a nuisance once{n}you teamed up with Maxwell?{p}{v:0028}So you ordered him to get rid of the man. Am I wrong?

entries.jp: {v:0029}なかなか鋭いじゃねぇか。{p}{v:002A}マクスウェルと組んだのは正解だったぜ。{n}ま、使い物にならねぇ魔法も多かったけどな。
entries.en: {v:0029}You're pretty sharp.{p}{v:002A}Teaming up with Maxwell was the right move. Though{n}plenty of his magic was useless.

entries.jp: {v:002B}僕たちの研究成果をそんなことに使っていたのか！？
entries.en: {v:002B}You were using the results of our research for that?!

entries.jp: {v:0019}ぐおぉっ！{n}そんな‥‥バカな‥‥。{n}俺様の武器が‥負けるわけ‥ねぇ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0019}Gwaaah! That's... impossible... My weapons... can't... lose...

entries.jp: {v:001A}お前の戦い方は、武器に頼りすぎだぜ。
entries.en: {v:001A}You rely too much on your weapons.

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:001B}ダメだ‥もっと‥もっと金が‥金が‥‥金‥‥
entries.en: ...{v:001B}No... I need more... more money... money... money...

entries.jp: おいしい話だって聞いたのに‥‥。{n}話が違う‥‥
entries.en: I heard this was easy money... This ain't what I signed{n}up for...

entries.jp: {v:0007}また会ったな。{p}{v:0008}ま、今度は敵としてだがな。
entries.en: {v:0007}We meet again.{p}{v:0008}As enemies this time, though.

entries.jp: {v:0009}そろそろ言ったらどうなんだ？{n}お前の目的をな！
entries.en: {v:0009}Isn't it about time you told us what you're after?!

entries.jp: {v:000A}簡単なことよ。{n}この世で１番尊いもののためだ。
entries.en: {v:000A}Simple. I'm doing it for the most precious thing in{n}the world.
{v:000B}What could be the most precious thing?
{v:000F}That's the most worthless thing of all.

entries.jp: {v:0011}この世で１番尊いもの。{n}それは{FFEF}金{FFF1}だ！
entries.en: {v:0011}The most precious thing in the world is {FFEF}money{FFF1}!

entries.jp: {v:0013}そう、力の時代は終わる。{n}これからは商売が世界を支配するのだ！{p}{v:0014}どんな権力者も金には逆らえない。{n}金さえあれば何でも出来る！{p}{v:0015}俺の作った武器がもっと金を運んでくるまで、{n}この戦争は続けさせてもらう。{p}{v:0016}そのためにも、お前たちは邪魔だ！{n}ここで死ね！
entries.en: {v:0013}That's right. The age of might is ending. From now on,{n}trade will rule the world!{p}{v:0014}Even the most powerful ruler can't defy money. With{n}enough money, you can do anything!{p}{v:0015}I'll keep this war going until the weapons I've made bring{n}me even more money.{p}{v:0016}And you're in the way! Die here!
